title: SCNet P0 R05 capture-ledger velocity bracket and 2000 m/s mesh qualification

provenance.parent_assessment: P0 response calibration denied; all five medium-mesh speeds perforated and the 2000 m/s mesh response was inconsistent
provenance.change_scope: case design and measurement contract only; material, EOS, contact, section, geometry, and timestep controls remain unchanged

symmetry.validity: normal incidence, face-on cube, centered impact only

solver_controls.rationale: Retain the solver-read R04 control cards so R05 isolates the lower-speed design and measurement-contract repair. No material or erosion parameter is tuned against R04 outcomes.

capture_plane.element_position: 8-node arithmetic centroid; element contributions are aggregated with initial reference-mass weights
capture_plane.crossing_velocity: linear interpolation between bracketing d3part states

measurement_contract.reference_mass_basis: initial fragment solid-element reference volumes times density; the D3PART quarter-model ledger is compared against the per-case expected quarter mass before any symmetry scaling
measurement_contract.expected_reference_mass_source: p0_case_part_map.csv fragment_initial_reference_mass_kg, identity-bound by case_id and fragment_part_id
measurement_contract.runtime_completeness_policy: sum of D3PART fragment element reference masses must match the identity-bound expected quarter mass within initial_discrete_mass_relative_error_max; otherwise all primary QoI are unavailable

primary_qois.name: qM
primary_qois.definition: first-crossing fragment reference mass divided by the identity-bound expected initial fragment quarter mass

primary_qois.name: qP
primary_qois.definition: outward-positive scalar first-crossing momentum sum(mass*max(-vz,0)) divided by the positive initial incident momentum magnitude expected_reference_mass_kg*v0

primary_qois.name: qE
primary_qois.definition: first-crossing element-centroid translational kinetic energy divided by 0.5*expected_reference_mass_kg*v0^2; it excludes unresolved intra-element velocity-gradient energy

primary_qois.name: qV_over_v0
primary_qois.definition: reference-mass-weighted outward-positive first-crossing speed divided by impact speed; available only when qM is at least the numerical-perforation mass threshold; qV_mps is derived exactly as qV_over_v0*impact_speed_mps

run_integrity.evaluation_window: all finite records from the first record with a finite nonzero total-energy denominator through normal termination, inclusive; report any excluded initialization records
run_integrity.total_energy_ratio_definition: GLSTAT total_energy(t) divided by total_energy at the first finite nonzero baseline record; every finite record in the evaluation window must lie within the limits
run_integrity.hourglass_ratio_definition: maximum over the evaluation window of abs(GLSTAT hourglass_energy(t)) divided by the maximum positive GLSTAT internal_energy over the same window
run_integrity.added_mass_fraction_definition: maximum nonnegative solver-reported added mass divided by the initial physical model mass

capture_ledger.failure_policy: mark primary QoI unavailable; never replace unavailable with zero

speed_scan.qV_mps_definition: qV_over_v0 multiplied by that case's impact_speed_mps
speed_scan.qV_downward_jump_comparison: compare only adjacent cases in the complete speed-sorted scan when both cases are confirmed_perforation; pairs containing transition, indeterminate, unavailable, or confirmed_nonperforation are not silently bridged
speed_scan.reporting_boundary: deterministic numerical transition bracket only; do not report experimental V50 or confidence intervals

admission.p0_response_calibration: allow only if every applicable gate passes
admission.p1_submission: remain denied until P0 response calibration is allowed
admission.physical_validation: requires independent experimental evidence; cannot be established by R05
